standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that in a Hausdorff space a point can be separated from a closed subset disjoint from it by open sets, for quasi-compact closed subsets
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2313-2315)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a neighbourhood of the point whose closure misses the complement of a covering member.

core_obligations: Pointwise step: for a point in a member of the covering, separate it from the closed complement of that member and take the closure of the separating neighbourhood (proof lines 2309-2316)
Finiteness: quasi-compactness of the space turns the resulting family of neighbourhoods into a finite subcover (proof lines 2317-2318)
Regroup: the neighbourhoods attached to the same covering member are collected, and their closures lie in that member, which gives the asserted refinement (proof lines 2318-2319)
proof_roadmap: 取 x，选 i(x) 使 x ∈ U_{i(x)}；X ∖ U_{i(x)} 与 {x} 是不相交闭集，由 Hausdorff 分离性取 x 的开邻域 U_x 使闭包(U_x) ∩ (X ∖ U_{i(x)}) = ∅，即闭包(U_x) ⊂ U_{i(x)}。
由 X 准紧，取有限个 x_1, …, x_m 使 X = U_{x_1} ∪ … ∪ U_{x_m}。
按 i(x_j) 归并这些 U_{x_j} 得 V_i，则 V_i ⊂ 闭包(V_i) ⊂ U_i，即所求细化。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an open covering of a quasi-compact Hausdorff space can be refined by open subsets whose closures lie inside the members of the covering (author lemma at source lines 2301-2307, label lemma-relatively-compact-refinement). The proof (source lines 2309-2320) separates each point from the closed complement of a covering member, takes the closure of the resulting neighbourhood, extracts a finite subcover by quasi-compactness and regroups the neighbourhoods by the member they refine (proof lines 2309-2319). The pointwise separation and the regrouping are the substance. H3.
